scripts.dev: npm run build -w @caixa/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web 'npm run dev -w @caixa/api' 'npm run dev -w @caixa/web'
scripts.build: npm run build -w @caixa/shared && npm run build -w @caixa/api && npm run build -w @caixa/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @caixa/shared && npm run test -w @caixa/api
scripts.seed: npm run build -w @caixa/shared && npm run seed -w @caixa/api
scripts.import:history: npm run build -w @caixa/shared && npm run import:history -w @caixa/api
